title: CSV parser mangles quotes and trailing newlines
prompt: The CSV helpers in this project misbehave on real exports. Fields such as `"say ""hi"""` lose their doubled quotes; a file that ends with a newline produces an extra empty row; rows shorter than the header give `undefined` values instead of empty strings in `toObjects`; and `toCsv` does not escape quotes or quote fields that contain the delimiter. Find the causes and fix them. Run the tests with `npm test`.
